name: Unidentified tactical droid
description: This T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid served in the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid had white sensor color and light and dark plating. It stood at 1.93 meters tall.
